rules.message: On XElement, HaveAttribute(name, value) in AwesomeAssertions checks only the name. The second argument becomes the because text, so the test passes with a wrong value. On XmlElement (System.Xml) the call is correct.
Since FluentAssertions 8, AllSatisfy and OnlyContain pass on an empty collection. Check that an empty collection is not a bug here.
rules.fix: Add .NotBeEmpty() before the call when the collection must have items.
